_about: The reporting control register. Every automated check the platform runs over regulatory reporting, named as a control: its objective, category, type, how often it runs, what it covers, the evidence it leaves, and the regulatory expectation it answers. Each control is tested by the register sweep (daily) and on demand; the outcome of every test is recorded so operating effectiveness has a history. No sector is named: a control applies to every tenant type unless `sectors` restricts it.

controls.label: Every filing rests on an immutable frozen snapshot
controls.frequency: on every filing validation; daily sweep
controls.objective: A figure that reaches a regulator cannot change after release.
controls.anchor: CSRD limited/reasonable assurance · ECB Guide on climate-related risks (expectation 10, data governance)

controls.label: Frozen payload matches its content hash
controls.frequency: on every filing validation; daily sweep
controls.objective: Detect any drift or tampering of a released report.
controls.anchor: ISAE 3000 evidence integrity · EBA Pillar 3 data quality

controls.label: The filing is complete enough to release
controls.frequency: on every filing validation; daily sweep
controls.objective: No filing releases without a book, scored positions, identity and a built statement.
controls.evidence: blocking completeness findings per live filing
controls.anchor: Framework templates (Pillar 3 ESG, SFDR PAI, ESRS E1) mandatory content

controls.label: Coverage of optional but expected content
controls.frequency: on every filing validation; daily sweep
controls.objective: Surface gaps a supervisor will ask about (coverage, indicators, emissions, narratives).
controls.anchor: Framework guidance on completeness of disclosures

controls.label: Figures are plausible
controls.frequency: on every filing validation; daily sweep
controls.objective: Totals positive, shares within range, emissions non-negative.
controls.anchor: EBA Pillar 3 data quality · supervisory plausibility checks

controls.label: The filing ties out internally
controls.frequency: on every filing validation; daily sweep
controls.objective: Severity buckets sum to the book; value-at-risk equals the High+ buckets.
controls.anchor: Internal reconciliation expected by every framework

controls.label: Shared figures agree across filings
controls.frequency: on every filing validation; daily sweep
controls.objective: The same figure reported in two frameworks or two periods is reconciled and differences explained.
controls.anchor: Consistency between Pillar 3, TCFD, CSRD and SFDR disclosures

controls.label: Every release is approved by a second person
controls.objective: No filing reaches submitted or accepted without a maker/checker approval.
controls.evidence: approval request per released filing; readiness check

controls.label: Reporting identity is complete
controls.objective: LEI (or EORI) and a filing contact are on record before anything is filed.
controls.anchor: Regulatory portals require the identifier on every submission

controls.label: The golden source is fresh
controls.objective: No basis feed is overdue or failed when a filing is computed.

controls.label: Inputs are filing-grade
controls.objective: Located assets carry a precise location and a score before they enter a filing.

controls.label: Published figures rest on models that pass the gate
controls.objective: Every active model that publishes a euro figure has an out-of-sample r² of at least 0.40; below it the model is screening only.
controls.anchor: SR 11-7 / ECB TRIM model validation · Tellumen publish gate

controls.label: Appetite breaches are seen and owned
controls.objective: Every open red breach is acknowledged within seven days of onset.
controls.anchor: Risk appetite framework · ECB Guide expectation 4

controls.label: Regulatory sources are scanned on cadence
controls.objective: The official sources of every tracked framework were checked within the last seven days.

controls.label: No obligation is overdue without a filing
controls.objective: Every obligation past its due date has a submitted or accepted filing for that framework and period.
